params.prompt: Restyle the first attached image (our chosen concept, Getaway Route daily-reward screen) into a darker, stealth look for Blackout Crew, a blacked-out heist game. KEEP the exact overall structure and layout: title lockup top-left with a kart, isometric rooftop route of 7 stash stops running left to right climbing to the Directive tower vault on Day 7, kart driving the route, repo drones with vision cones over locked days, bottom-left DAY 3 REWARD card with big CLAIM button, bottom-right streak + tomorrow's reward + timer pills, close X top-right. Keep state logic: DAY 1 and DAY 2 CLAIMED with green checks, DAY 3 TODAY (largest, raised, lit), DAY 4 to 7 LOCKED with padlock pills. Same text as the first image, EXCEPT remove the 'EVENT ENDS IN' pill entirely, and make the close X plain dark (not red). The second image is only a craft and depth reference. Art direction: overall BLACK. Near-black matte buildings and UI panels, charcoal and graphite materials, stealth, mysterious, modern, minimalist, clean sparse UI with thin precise lines, no clutter. Light comes only from restrained sources: thin cool LED-white edge lighting on panels, pill outlines and rooftop edges, small white window lights, and a warm gold glow on the TODAY item (Day 3) only. No other colored glow, no neon, no rainbow. Squad blue only as a tiny accent on the kart. Keep 3D chunky Roblox-blocky props with bevels and specular highlights, soft depth of field, dark night city, moon. Kid-friendly, no blood, no real guns, no real brands. Variant 1: pure stealth black. Almost monochrome black and graphite, white LED edge-light accents, gold glow on Day 3 only, title in white and gold.
